rapport_notes: Patient and apologetic about the walkthrough system being down, but several math/communication errors on total hours and cost created visible confusion for the customer.
process_discipline_notes: No repeated differentiators found, but repeated numeric errors caused the customer to have to correct/re-ask the rep multiple times.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if you still have extra time, like you have mentioned, to pack some of the small items, that would really help complete the time down in efficiency up

top_strength: Adapted the quote down after the customer pushed back with credible detail about how much of the move was already done, rather than rigidly defending the original number.
coaching_note: The initial square-footage-based estimate (16 hours over two days) was wildly out of line with what the customer described and caused real friction ('what's gonna take so long?') — should verify against stated inventory before quoting hours, not just square footage.
